descriptions.w3d_d29e_create_if_derived_801a01f0: Queries the service at 0x8020b648 for the interface 0x804138b0 into a held reference, looks up an entry by name (slot 3) and, if the entry exists and base is null or found on the entry's parent chain at +20, returns the result of the entry's create call at table offset 88; otherwise returns 0. Names are inferred.
